title.purpose: Prototype title on the numbered rail.

body.purpose: Page default and trade line (trade at weight 500).

shadows.name: overlay-rest
shadows.purpose: Soft drop under the injected mockup overlay so the seal sits on a foreign page. Overlay-only; never on the letterhead.

shadows.name: overlay-hover
shadows.purpose: Fuller overlay drop on hover, paired with a 1px rise. Overlay-only.

motion.name: platter
motion.purpose: Slow rotation of the mast groove rings only. The engraving label does not spin. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: overlay-hover-lift
motion.purpose: 1px rise on overlay hover. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

VITROLA

components.css: .ds-mast { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: end; column-gap: 1.25rem; padding-bottom: 1.35rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #141414; color: #141414; } .ds-wordmark { margin: 0; font-family: "Schibsted Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(3rem, 10vw, 6rem); font-weight: 700; line-height: 0.9; letter-spacing: -0.035em; color: #141414; } .ds-trade { margin: 0.7rem 0 0; font-family: "Schibsted Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #141414; } .ds-seal { position: relative; width: 7.25rem; height: 7.25rem; color: #141414; } .ds-grooves { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; animation: ds-platter 90s linear infinite; transform-origin: 50% 50%; } .ds-horn { position: absolute; inset: 22%; width: 56%; height: 56%; border-radius: 50%; background: #E8E7E2; } @keyframes ds-platter { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-grooves { animation: none; } }

components.css: .ds-phonograph { position: relative; width: 8.5rem; height: 8.5rem; color: #141414; } .ds-phonograph-grooves { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; animation: ds-phonograph-platter 90s linear infinite; transform-origin: 50% 50%; } .ds-phonograph-label { position: absolute; inset: 22%; width: 56%; height: 56%; border-radius: 50%; background: #E8E7E2; } @keyframes ds-phonograph-platter { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-phonograph-grooves { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
VITROLA is the web software factory's evaluation room, nested as a house brand inside a client product repo. This surface is not a product landing and not a card gallery. It is the letterhead the client came to use: studio name at display scale, trade line, a grooved phonograph disc with the vitrola engraving as its label, a measured brief, then a numbered staff of prototypes. The list is the document. The disc is the house mark — the object the house is named for.

The field is uncoated paper; the voice is black ink. Hierarchy is Schibsted Grotesk in size and weight steps. Modules sit flush left on one sheet. Rows are open type on the field — no tiles, no enclosure, no lift. Client name (Dr. Rocha) appears as a fact in the brief and colophon; it does not lend clinical color, chrome, or product UI to this letterhead. On mockups, the same circular mark is injected as a floating return overlay; it is house chrome on a foreign page, not a second surface on the letterhead.
keyCharacteristics: Paper field, ink type, ink staff rules — one material on the sheet
Grooved disc with ink-engraving label on the mast; same mark as the mockup overlay
Single grotesque; display through label are size steps of the same face
Flush-left modules on a 12-column sheet; the brief is a measure, not a card
Numbered rail is the only action on the gallery; hover underlines the title
Square letterhead except the disc; signal wine appears only as the focus ring

rules.name: The Ink-on-Paper Rule
rules.body: The field is paper. Type, staff, and grooves are ink. Diluted ink is for secondary reading. Signal is reserved for focus.

rules.name: The Size-Step Rule
rules.body: One family. Hierarchy is size, weight, and tracking. Never introduce a display serif, a mono for chrome, or a second grotesque.

rules.name: The Module Rule
rules.body: One grid, typographic state. Modules are flush-left blocks on the sheet. Do not center the brief as a card, and do not park content in interior columns for decoration.

rules.name: The Staff Rule
rules.body: The list is a vertical staff of full ink rules. Rules are 1px solid ink on paper — not diluted hairlines, not box strokes around a tile.

rules.name: The Round Exception Rule
rules.body: The letterhead is square. The only circle is the phonograph disc — mast seal and overlay. Nothing else is round.

rules.name: The No Enclosure Rule
rules.body: A prototype is a row on the staff, not a card. No fill, radius, border-box, or shadow around the item.

rules.name: The Exposed Count Rule
rules.body: A folder is a row: number, slug, title, optional summary/status, open.

rules.name: The Grooves-Only Rule
rules.body: The platter turns the groove rings only (90s linear, infinite). The engraving label stays still. Under prefers-reduced-motion, the disc does not spin.

dos: Do set the studio wordmark at display scale, keep the trade line directly under it, and trail the identity with the grooved disc.
Do treat the numbered rail as the only action on the first viewport.
Do draw staff rules in 1px solid ink (mast, row tops, rail foot).
Do underline the prototype title on hover and focus-visible (1px, offset 0.18em) and nowhere else.
Do keep the brief in the 38rem measure and the sheet flush left.
Do inject the same circular mark onto mockups as the return overlay.
donts: Don't enclose rows in cards, tiles, chips, or bordered panels.
Don't bring Dr. Rocha clinical/teal product tokens onto this letterhead.
Don't add a kicker or room-label above the heading; the trade line under the wordmark is the only house identification.
Don't animate rows on entrance, stagger, or cascade. The sheet is still; the only motion is the groove spin.
Don't introduce a second type family, a second mark, or a filled accent button as the primary action. The rail opens prototypes; the disc is the house seal, not a CTA.
Don't round anything except the disc, spin the engraving, or place the overlay on the gallery.
